text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of them had no choice but 
to look at me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal, the Arima Kinen, is the 
perfect stage to show the world what I'm 
truly made of—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, Fine Motion shall serve as our 
"witness." If even her resolve to accept 
fate can be overturned, the proof will be 
complete. */
